payload.text: vc, 23 Nov 2026: ST589246c's design (dc, d6a9728d: design.md, progress.md and WP 53ef's body), read against hv's account and hv decision 10, is approved for 53ef's code once its acceptance criteria are recorded. Three notes. (1) The display watcher (hs.screen.watcher, a change record and snapshots at 0, 5, 30 and 120 s) is the one part that runs outside an arngz run. It is how decision 10's time since the last display change is had, and so it is accepted under decision 10, with three conditions. Its callback and timers are guarded, so any failure goes to the log as an error record. Its timers are held in its global. hv's steps add a Hammerspoon reload after utilz use brew, because 2.14.10's engine does not know the watcher and would leave the dev tree's running. vc tells hv about the watcher when the build is ready. (2) Decision 9's (5) and (6), the five yq captures and the 600 s cap, ride 53ef rather than 93ea, as dc placed them: 53ef already edits those files, and its one booked run covers them. (3) F3 and F4 stay in 93ea's scope, as decision 10 has them. dc's recommendation, "leave them out unless hv's run logs them again: each has happened once", goes to hv in dc's words with 93ea's scope after the diagnosis run. Also: hv need not send the log, because vc reads ~/.local/state/arngz/arngz.log itself.
